summary: This is a routine Form 6-K foreign private issuer report filed by Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico (Pacific Airport Group) disclosing May 2026 preliminary passenger traffic data. It provides month-over-month and year-to-date comparisons for domestic, international, and total terminal passengers across its 12 Mexican and 2 Jamaican airports. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or material corporate action—is described. The filing contains only operational metrics and is a standard monthly traffic update required under home-country exchange rules. It does not constitute a special situation under event-driven analysis.
